description: Inheritance model for specialization and generalization.

modes.semantics: Child inherits constraints and may add narrower conditions.
Parent defines shared attributes reused by children.
Two concepts denote the same meaning under mapping.
modes.example: vi label equivalent_to en label for the same KR id

modes.semantics: Whole groups parts without exclusive ownership.
Whole is composed of essential parts.

rules: Inheritance never mutates the parent object.
Children may narrow but not silently contradict immutable parent identity.
Multiple inheritance is discouraged; if used, override_rules.json decides precedence.
Structural contains/belongs_to must not be confused with semantic inherits/specializes.
